opinions.evaluation: Two complete low hands, both thumb webs attached to their own mitten bodies.
No coral material remains on either gold neck.
Purple tabletop separates both mittens from necks and fan upper edges.
Hands are back above the neck region, close to the former contact rather than at final wide rest.
Both whole hands remain low and relaxed, with intact cuffs.
Thin-paper winds grow into rounded bulky rope-like coils, especially the right end; this changes the wrapper material.
Broad gold fans remain continuous and broadly registered, with small upper-profile changes.
One opaque oval remains supported and registered.
Main identity is coherent, inherited room stays separate.
Rejected for bulky coil material despite a substantially cleaner low-handed release pose.
